newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank clears Ford Credit bank licence.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank clears Ford Credit bank licence.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland (NBP), the central bank, has cleared a banking operations licence for Ford Credit Europe Plc, a unit of Ford Motor Co., the NBP said on Wednesday.
"The positive assessment of Ford Credit Europe's bid for a licence is connected with its placing a low interest loan with WBK bank," NBP spokeswoman Renata Wisniewska told Reuters.
She also said the loan for WBK, value of which was not disclosed, was connected with the Polish banks' plan to take over a branch of the failed Bydgoski Bank Budownictwa (BBB).
Before launching banking operations in Poland, Ford would also need an approval of the finance ministry, which said on Wednesday it was analysing the banking licence application.
Officials of Ford, which assembles passenger cars and vans in Poland and has a network of dealers, were not available for comment.
Last month Poland's Banking Guarantee Fund (BFG) agreed to lend WBK, 36 percent owned by Allied Irish Bank Plc, 8.6 million zlotys to help it take over BBB's branch.
The NBP's and the finance ministry's policy provides for granting banking licences to institutions investing in Poland's financial sector.
